headline: Alivus Life Sciences announces acquisition of majority stake in IQGenX
sum: Alivus Life Sciences has acquired a majority stake in IQGenX, a transaction announced via NSE/BSE press release on 18 August 2026.
implication: Listed acquirers in the life sciences space using majority stake structures must navigate SEBI takeover code thresholds, foreign investment clearances (if applicable), and integration compliance in a regulated pharma environment.
detail: Alivus Life Sciences Limited, a BSE/NSE-listed entity, announced the acquisition of a majority stake in IQGenX through an official exchange-notified press release. The transaction was disclosed via the NSE archive on 18 August 2026. Exact consideration, percentage stake acquired, and deal conditions were not detailed in the headline announcement and require review of the full press release document and any subsequent exchange disclosures or company investor relations announcements.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
framework.note: Majority acquisition triggers open offer obligation at 25% threshold; exemptions under Reg. 4 may apply (inter-alia agreement, reorganisation).
If structured as a scheme or merger, approval route under Part VIII; requires NCLT sanction and shareholder vote.

framework.ref: Foreign Exchange Management Act, 1999 (FEMA) – Schedules I–III, Rule 2
framework.note: If target is Indian resident or has foreign ownership, FDI clearance via FIPB/DPIIT may be required depending on sector and shareholding.
Manufacturing and licensing approvals; if target manufactures pharmaceuticals, transfer or continuance of licences post-acquisition is mandatory.

framework.ref: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 – Chapter XVII (Corporate Governance post M&A)
framework.note: Director appointment, disclosure of related-party transactions, insider trading compliance under SEBI (PFUTP) Rules, 2015.

framework.ref: SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Reg. 30, 33
framework.note: Material event disclosure within 24 hours; impact on EPS and net worth disclosure; approval by Audit Committee and Board mandatory.
Tax treatment of acquisition: cost of acquisition, stamp duty on transfer, capital gains on share sale; Benami Transactions Prohibition Act, 1988 compliance.

conditions: Majority stake acquisition (>50% equity ownership implied)
Exchange notification and press release disclosure
approvals: Potential SEBI open offer exemption or takeover code filing (status unclear)
structure.novel: Standard majority-stake acquisition by listed acquirer; no novel structuring indicated in announcement.

triggers.note: Acquisition >25% triggers disclosure and potential open offer; exemption route depends on final structure and regulatory approval.
Material acquisition announcement must be disclosed within 24 hours to exchanges; impact on acquirer's EPS and net worth requires audit committee approval.
If target is a pharma manufacturer, manufacturing licence transfer and regulatory continuance are gate items.

firms.note: No law firms named in the primary NSE press release headline or excerpt provided.
